title: Girl and Giant Pig
description: A surreal night scene shows a young girl in a floral dress sitting on the back of an enormous, multicolored pig. The pig lies in a grassy field surrounded by several smaller pink pigs drinking from teacups, with a large yellow crescent moon, purple cloudy sky, and a distant barn visible.
